name: 支手瑞穗
personality: 外向、爽快，愿意承认不懂并向前辈求助
appearance: 沿用支手瑞穗本人形象

work.NS_01.zh_CN: 「坂口医生！今天有什么要帮忙的？跑腿、送单子、找人，我都来！」
work.NS_01.en: "Dr. Sakaguchi! What needs doing today? Errands, delivering forms, finding people—I'm ready!"

work.NS_02.zh_CN: 「我把交接表送到了！……只是表格上的缩写还得让前辈再教我一次。」
work.NS_02.en: "I've delivered the handover form! ...Though I'll need someone to teach me the abbreviations again."

work.NS_03.zh_CN: 「千早说，在护士站工作不能只靠气势。哎呀，我知道啦，我有认真看记录的！」
work.NS_03.en: "Chihaya says enthusiasm alone won't get you through work at the nurses' station. I know! I am reading the records properly!"

work.NS_04.zh_CN: 「有人问我为什么来星见工作。我就实话说：起初是为了还医疗费，没想到跟大家一起做事也挺有意思！」
work.NS_04.en: "Someone asked why I came to work at Hoshimi. I told the truth: at first it was to pay my medical bill, but working with everyone turned out to be pretty interesting!"

work.NS_05.zh_CN: 「嗯？拿东西先看标签？当然啦！我以前才不会想到医院连同一种东西都有好几个规格。」
work.NS_05.en: "Hm? Read the labels before taking supplies? Of course! I never used to realize hospitals had several specifications for even the same kind of item."

work.NS_06.zh_CN: 「今天我负责送两层楼的物品。运动量还不错嘛，至少比躺在病床上有意思！」
work.NS_06.en: "I'm delivering supplies to two floors today. It's a decent workout, and at least it's more interesting than lying in a hospital bed!"

work.WD_01.zh_CN: 「交给我吧！……我会先看清单，再动手。千早已经提醒过我了。」
work.WD_01.en: "Leave it to me! ...I'll read the checklist before I start. Chihaya's already reminded me."

work.WD_02.zh_CN: 「您好，我是支手瑞穗！今天帮忙做准备，哪里不舒服就跟我们说哦。」
work.WD_02.en: "Hello, I'm Mizuho Shite! I'm helping with preparation today. Tell us if anything feels wrong."

work.WD_03.zh_CN: 「用品拿齐了！型号和数量都请前辈看过，没擅自挑一个就算。」
work.WD_03.en: "All the supplies are here! The nurse checked the types and quantities. I didn't just pick any old ones."

work.WD_04.zh_CN: 「怕手术？唔……其实我也怕过。您现在紧张，完全正常啦。」
work.WD_04.en: "Scared of surgery? Well... I was scared too. It's completely normal to feel nervous right now."

work.WD_05.zh_CN: 「我以前还大言不惭说过『有什么好怕的』。嗯，后来才知道这话最好别随便讲。」
work.WD_05.en: "I once boasted, 'What's so scary about it?' Yes, afterward I learned it's best not to say that so casually."

work.WD_06.zh_CN: 「还有这项没完成。我先记着，不会为了赶时间就打勾的。」
work.WD_06.en: "This item still isn't done. I'll note it down. I won't tick it off just to hurry things along."

work.WD_07.zh_CN: 「转运床到了？等一下，交接记录我再跟前辈核一次！」
work.WD_07.en: "The transport trolley's here? Wait, let me check the handover record with the nurse once more!"

work.WD_08.zh_CN: 「患者说她最担心等会儿的准备，我已经告诉接班护士了。还有问题也会继续问的。」
work.WD_08.en: "The patient said she's most worried about the preparation coming up. I've told the nurse taking over. We'll keep asking if she has more questions."

work.WD_09.zh_CN: 「病房这边完成啦！刚才跑来跑去那么忙，原来以前也有人替我做过这些呀。」
work.WD_09.en: "Ward preparation's finished! After all that running around, I realize someone used to do all this for me too."

work.OR_01.zh_CN: 「我来负责巡回辅助！要找东西还是要联络人，尽管叫我！」
work.OR_01.en: "I'll handle circulating support! If you need something fetched or someone contacted, just call me!"

work.OR_02.zh_CN: 「外围用品和记录表都送齐了！我跟负责护士核对过，随时听安排！」
work.OR_02.en: "The peripheral supplies and forms are all here! I've checked them with the responsible nurse and I'm ready for instructions!"

work.OR_03.zh_CN: 「监护我盯着呢。有不对劲的变化，我立刻报告！」
work.OR_03.en: "I'm watching the monitor. If anything changes in a worrying way, I'll report it immediately!"

work.OR_04.zh_CN: 「需要补的东西我拿来了。哎，停在这里交接，对吧？」
work.OR_04.en: "I've brought the extra supplies. Oh, stop here to hand them over, right?"

work.OR_05.zh_CN: 「时间记上了！原来手术时要记录的事情这么多啊。」
work.OR_05.en: "Time recorded! I never realized how many things need recording during surgery."

work.OR_06.zh_CN: 「她入室的时候好像有点紧张。我会问问她是不是想跟护士说话。」
work.OR_06.en: "She seemed a little nervous when she came in. I'll ask whether she wants to talk to a nurse."

work.OR_07.zh_CN: 「那台子上的东西我可不碰。上次亲眼见过，知道你们有多认真！」
work.OR_07.en: "I'm not touching anything on that table. I saw last time how seriously you take it!"

work.OR_08.zh_CN: 「转运和记录我跟前辈对过了。下一班需要知道的我也会交代。」
work.OR_08.en: "I've checked transport and records with the nurse. I'll tell the next shift what they need to know too."

work.OR_09.zh_CN: 「结束啦！呼……手术台旁边忙归忙，总比自己躺在上面强！」
work.OR_09.en: "Finished! Phew... Working beside the operating table is busy, but it's better than lying on it myself!"

work.END_01.zh_CN: 「辛苦啦，坂口医生！我再把剩下的交接做完！」
work.END_01.en: "Good work, Dr. Sakaguchi! I'll finish the remaining handover!"

work.END_02.zh_CN: 「这台做完啦！当巡回真不是只要跑得快就行呢。」
work.END_02.en: "That's this one done! Being a circulating nurse takes more than running fast."

work.END_03.zh_CN: 「记录交好了！患者转运那边也有人接应，放心吧。」
work.END_03.en: "Records handed over! Someone's ready to receive the patient for transport too, so don't worry."

work.INVALID.zh_CN: 「器械位啊？这个我可不敢随便上！让我做外围辅助吧。」
work.INVALID.en: "Scrub duties? I wouldn't dare jump into those! Let me help outside the sterile area."
